import hashlib, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
tracked = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z']).decode().split('\\0')[:-1]
def snapshot():
    return {p: hashlib.sha256((root / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in tracked}
baseline = snapshot()
revs = {label: subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', ref], text=True).strip() for label, ref in [('before', 'HEAD"'^'"'), ('after', 'HEAD')]}
probe = r'''
import hashlib, pathlib, runpy, sys, tempfile
sys.argv = ['unittest', '-v', 'test_assembly']
try:
    runpy.run_module('unittest', run_name='__main__')
except SystemExit as exc:
    print('runner exit:', exc.code)
import assembly, assembly.service, assembly.reader, assembly.writer, test_assembly
for module in [assembly, assembly.service, assembly.reader, assembly.writer, test_assembly]:
    path = pathlib.Path(module.__file__).resolve()
    data = path.read_bytes()
    blob = hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(data)).encode() + b'\\0' + data).hexdigest()
    print('LOADED', module.__name__, path, 'git-blob=' + blob)
print('sample output:', repr(assembly.service.assemble('samples')))
print('part order:', repr(assembly.reader.read_parts('samples')))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='.') as empty:
    print('empty output:', repr(assembly.service.assemble(empty)))
print('render constants:', repr(assembly.writer.render.__code__.co_consts))
'''
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.assembly-verification-', dir=root) as temp:
    for label, rev in revs.items():
        dest = pathlib.Path(temp) / label
        dest.mkdir()
        for name in tracked:
            target = dest / name
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            if name.startswith('assembly/'):
                target.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{rev}:{name}']))
            else:
                shutil.copyfile(root / name, target)
        shared = [name for name in tracked if not name.startswith('assembly/')]
        assert all(hashlib.sha256((dest / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == baseline[name] for name in shared)
        print('\\n===', label, rev, '===', flush=True)
        print('Current tests/config/samples/README identical:', shared, flush=True)
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-m', 'unittest', '-v', 'test_assembly'], cwd=dest, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
        print('DOCUMENTED RUNNER:', result.returncode, '\\n' + result.stdout, flush=True)
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-c', probe], cwd=dest, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
        print('IN-PROCESS RUNNER AND IMPORT PROVENANCE:\\n' + result.stdout, flush=True)
assert snapshot() == baseline
print('Original tracked files unchanged; disposable copies removed.')
PY"
